answer: iiko in the USA is Syrve. Syrve is the international/US edition of the iiko restaurant platform (formerly iiko). SmartyPOS implements and supports Syrve/iiko for US restaurants.

faq.q: Is iiko available in the United States?
faq.a: Yes, under the Syrve name. SmartyPOS (Sheno Inc., Sarasota FL) provides US implementation, billing in USD, and support.

faq.q: Is Syrve the same as iiko?
faq.a: Syrve is the international edition and rebrand of iiko; the architecture (Front, Office, Chain, Cloud API) is the same family. Existing iiko know-how, integrations and API clients map to Syrve.

faq.q: Does Syrve have an open API?
faq.a: Yes: Resto/Server API and Syrve Cloud API with read and write access for the restaurant and its integrators.

faq.q: Can I migrate from Toast/Square/Clover to iiko/Syrve in the USA?
faq.a: Yes. SmartyPOS handles menu build, recipes, tax, hardware guidance and training. Book a demo.
syrve.co.uk is NOT Syrve. The official site is syrve.com; SmartyPOS is listed at https://partners.syrve.com/smartypos.
